preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must contain only digits.
The string s must be non-empty.

postconditions.description: The number of ways to decode the string must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i+1, len(s)+1) if 1 <= int(s[i:j]) <= 26 and all(1 <= int(s[k:k+2]) <= 26 for k in range(i, j, 2)))
postconditions.description: The return value must be the total number of ways to decode the string s into letters A-Z.
